items.prompt: Two asks at 1000 have quantities 10 then 20. A market BUY 5 partially fills the first. What remains at the front?

options.text: The original first ask with 5 remaining.
options.why: A partial fill does not surrender that order's FIFO priority.

options.text: The second ask with 20, while the first moves to the back.
options.why: That would change time priority after a partial fill.

options.text: One aggregated order of 25 with no identity boundary.
options.why: Aggregation loses the separate trade-line boundaries required later.

options.text: No order, because any partial fill removes a level.
options.why: Positive resting quantity remains at that price.

items.explanation: A partial fill does not surrender that order's FIFO priority.
